# Creates the accumulator, the register index and the overflow flag if a key arrives before any reset.
ck3xbl_keypad_ensure_effect = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ck3xbl_acc } } set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_acc value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ck3xbl_idx } } set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_idx value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ck3xbl_overflow } } set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_overflow value = 0 } }
}

# acc = acc * 10 + $D$. A seventh digit (a lost store key merged two values) would leave the range of CK3's
# fixed-point values: it marks the payload invalid instead (the commit then logs IN|BAD) and restarts the value.
ck3xbl_keypad_digit_effect = {
	ck3xbl_keypad_ensure_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { var:ck3xbl_acc >= 100000 }
		set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_overflow value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_acc value = $D$ }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_acc value = { value = var:ck3xbl_acc multiply = 10 add = $D$ } } }
}

		else_if = { limit = { var:ck3xbl_idx = 143 } set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_r143 value = var:ck3xbl_acc } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:ck3xbl_idx = 144 } set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_r144 value = var:ck3xbl_acc } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:ck3xbl_idx = 145 } set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_r145 value = var:ck3xbl_acc } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:ck3xbl_idx = 146 } set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_r146 value = var:ck3xbl_acc } }
		else_if = { limit = { var:ck3xbl_idx = 147 } set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_r147 value = var:ck3xbl_acc } }

# F5: idx = acc, acc = 0
ck3xbl_keypad_seek_effect = {
	ck3xbl_keypad_ensure_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_idx value = var:ck3xbl_acc }
	set_variable = { name = ck3xbl_acc value = 0 }
}

# Removes every register variable from the player (after a battle has been applied or abandoned).
ck3xbl_keypad_clear_effect = {
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_r0
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_r1
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_r2
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_r3
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_r4
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_r5
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_r6
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_r7
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_r8
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_r9
	remove_variable = ck3xbl_r10

# F2: verify the checksum r199, the payload version r0 and r1 = global pending bid (docs/PROTOCOL.md 10.3).
# Version 3: r199 = sum of (r_i mod 9973) * ((i mod 16) + 1) mod 9973, i = 0..198; the weights
# catch registers stored one slot off (a repeated or lost store key), which a plain sum cannot.
# Version 4 (the battle clock, PROTOCOL 14.3) uses the version 3 checksum.
# Version 2 (older bridges): r199 = (r0 + ... + r198) mod 9973.
# The sum is reduced after every term, so intermediate values stay below 1,010,000 (fixed point).
# Logs IN|OK (sets ck3xbl_ready = 1) or IN|BAD. Both dumps carry ck3xbl_in_maxver = 4, the newest version this mod
# accepts, so the bridge can tell it from a mod before PROTOCOL 14. Pressing it twice is harmless.
ck3xbl_commit_effect = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ck3xbl_r199 } } ck3xbl_keypad_reset_effect = yes }
	ck3xbl_keypad_ensure_effect = yes
	save_scope_value_as = { name = ck3xbl_bid value = var:ck3xbl_r1 }
	save_scope_value_as = {
		name = ck3xbl_in_sum
		value = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = { var:ck3xbl_r0 = 2 }
				add = var:ck3xbl_r0 modulo = 9973
				add = var:ck3xbl_r1 modulo = 9973
				add = var:ck3xbl_r2 modulo = 9973
				add = var:ck3xbl_r3 modulo = 9973
				add = var:ck3xbl_r4 modulo = 9973
				add = var:ck3xbl_r5 modulo = 9973
